channelTitle: The horseman chased him to the bridge - all they found was a shattered pumpkin - Part 2
hook: In Part 1, Ichabod Crane rode home from the harvest party alone - already nervous, already listening for hooves behind him.
storyParts: The ride home was pitch dark, every stump looking like a crouching figure - then the bushes moved, and a huge shape on horseback rolled out of the shadows beside him.
The rider carried his head on the saddle in front of him. Ichabod kicked his old plow horse Gunpowder into a gallop, racing for the one place a ghost could not cross - the church bridge.
He made it - almost. At the bridge he looked back just in time to see the horseman hurl his head at him. It knocked Ichabod tumbling, and horse and rider thundered past into the dark.
Next morning they found Gunpowder grazing, Ichabod's hat lying in the road - and beside it, a shattered pumpkin. The schoolteacher himself was never seen in Sleepy Hollow again.
The tale never says who the rider was - but old Brom Bones laughed a little too knowingly whenever anyone mentioned the pumpkin, and he married Katrina soon after.
cta: Ghost or prank - which do you believe? Tell Grandma June your theory in the comments.
moral: Sometimes the scariest monster is the one wearing a neighbor's boots.
seriesTitle: The Headless Horseman - Grandma June Story Time
